examples.explanation: A total area of 6 is covered by all three rectangles, as illustrated in the picture. From (1,1) to (2,2), the green and red rectangles overlap. From (1,0) to (2,3), all three rectangles overlap.
The answer is 1018 modulo (109 + 7), which is 49.
